title: Mixed Event — Smile of a Dreamer — Episode7 The Place I Want to Protect

meta.Episode: Episode7 — The Place I Want to Protect
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime picks up the pace in preparation for their final Show Contest performance! At the same time, Emu learns that her brothers are working on a huge overhaul of Phoenix Wonderland. She tries to convince them to reconsider, but will she be successful?

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wonder why Tsukasa wants us to go on the Ferris wheel...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, this goes up pretty high.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It does. Even though we're only about halfway up, we get a great view of the park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The park...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The fish coaster's all tarped over now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Are they tearing that down too then...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Its cars were so cute because they looked like fishies and little kids would ride them all the time...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They always looked like they were having fun...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The merry-go-round over there is also pretty old too, so...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Look over there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is that...? The Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait... Why does the Wonder Stage look different from everything else...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It used to look more run down before...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, right... Our audience helps make it a livelier place now!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And some little kids are waiting at the entrance.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're wearing uniforms so maybe they're on their way home from school.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (All those smiles... It's like when grandpa was still here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's quite a bit different from before now, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our little stage that was on the brink of collapsing now gets a full audience every day!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that, we're in the running to win the entire Show Contest!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And most importantly! We've made countless people smile each and every day up to this point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is what we as Wonderlands×Showtime are truly capable of!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And out of all of that comes a single fact...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A fact...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! The fact is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are no limits to what we can accomplish!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, so this was what you were planning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, it's not any different from what he usually comes up with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Listen, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know what exactly is bothering you, but remember what we talked about the last time we were here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order to make sure that you can make everyone smile, we want to do what we can to make you smile.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's not just me and you this time. You have Nene, Rui and Robo-Nene on your side.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So can you please tell us what took away that smile of yours?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And let's try to figure something out together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree with Tsukasa. You've given us so much already, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For a change, we should return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please, Emu. Let us help you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Grandpa, what do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I... I can't hold back my tears...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I promised not to cry anymore after we said goodbye to each other...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But they're saying that they want to help me smile...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to force yourself to smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you...
